subject: MPA: evidence staging, gating checkpoints and target close for pilot
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Mike Santos <mike.santos@pinegate.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-06-18T09:12:34Z
Subject: MPA: evidence staging, gating checkpoints and target close for pilot

Mike —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, attached is a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft that aligns the technical evaluation with the security/compliance gating we need to clear before pilot go-live. High-level ask from PineGate for the pilot: SOC 2 Type II report, SIG/CAIQ answers for our hosted offering, a signed DPA, and a clear data retention/ residency statement.

Quick proposed cadence (see attached Redwood_MAP_Timeline_v1.xlsx):
- Week 0 (today): MAP agreement and kickoff; receipt of procurement contacts and PO timeline
- Week 1: SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet exchange + initial SOC 2 artifacts request
- Week 2: DPA redline cycle (we'll share our template, please send your preferred clauses)
- Week 3: Evidence staging (logs, configuration docs, scoping statements)
- Week 4: Final acceptance checklist and signoff, target pilot start (can move sooner if DPA is agreed)

A few specifics we need from you to keep things moving: 
1) SOC 2: either your latest Type II report or permission to share Redwood's hosted control evidence under NDA.
2) SIG/CAIQ: we'll send our baseline answers; please flag any gaps or environment-specific exceptions.
3) DPA: we can accept a redline; Jordan will lead the negotiation.
4) Data retention: clarify retention windows per data type (PAI, logs, analytics), and whether EU residency is required.

I'll assign owners on our side: Jordan will take DPA and legal coordination, Grace will manage evidence intake and staging, I will run the MAP cadence and acceptance criteria.

If procurement needs a formal MSA/PO template to match your timelines loop Olivia in and we'll push the doc.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Timeline_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), Requested_Evidence_Index.pdf (index stub)
From: Mike Santos <mike.santos@pinegate.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@pinegate.com, Olivia Park <olivia.park@pinegate.com>
Date: 2029-06-18T10:03:12Z
Subject: Re: MPA: evidence staging, gating checkpoints and target close for pilot

Hannah —

Thanks, this looks good and aligns with how we run pilots. A few notes/questions from our side: 
- SOC 2: we don't publish third-party reports broadly; can you confirm what specific control evidence you need if we can't share the full report?
- SIG/CAIQ: we prefer to use our security@pinegate.com address to own that; I'll loop Olivia for internal approvals.
- DPA: procurement prefers we send our standard DPA first; will that be a blocker for you?
- Retention: PineGate's default is 7 years for regulatory logs and 90 days for analytics — some teams may ask for shorter windows. We may need to negotiate retention carveouts for the pilot.

Target: procurement would like to close commercial terms by end of Week 2. Is that feasible if DPA redline runs in parallel with evidence staging?

Thanks,

Mike Santos
Director, Platform Integrations
PineGate Finance

Attachment: PineGate_PO_Timeline.pdf (referenced by procurement)

Hi all —

Security team here. Quick checklist from PineGate Security so you can validate your intake: 
- SOC 2: we need the auditor letter (scope & period) and sample evidence for access control, change management, and incident response.
- SIG/CAIQ: please supply the completed CAIQ spreadsheet or mapping. We will run a gap list against our internal policies.
- Data retention: confirm whether Redwood will support separate retention windows by data type (PII, logs, metrics) and whether data can be scoped to US-only hosts for the pilot.
- DPA: we'll push our standard DPA to Redwood; look for redlines on security sections (encryption at rest, subprocessor list, breach notification SLA).

Two asks:
1) Can Redwood produce a short 'evidence-collection' bundle (one PDF) for the gate that our team can review quickly?
2) Confirmation that logs necessary for SOC 2 sampling (auth logs, admin activity) will be available in the intake folder within 3 business days of request.

Olivia Park
Security Operations Manager
PineGate Finance

Thanks for the clarity. Quick summary and owners so we don't miss the Week 2 commercial close: 
- DPA: Jordan will consolidate your redline (Jordan) and we target legal alignment within 48 business hours of receipt of your redline.
- SOC 2 artifacts: Grace will create the evidence bundle (Requested_Evidence_Index.pdf) and place samples into a secure intake folder by EOD tomorrow.
- SIG/CAIQ: Grace will share Redwood's baseline answers and a gap matrix; please add your comments directly in the CAIQ spreadsheet.
- Data retention/residency: Hannah to capture PineGate's retention windows (you mentioned 7 years for regulatory logs / 90 days analytics) and propose pilot carveouts: US-only hosting + 30-day analytics retention default unless otherwise requested.

Proposed close timeline: commercial terms signed by 2029-06-24, security gate evidence accepted by 2029-06-26, pilot start targeted for 2029-06-30. If any step slips we will use a one-week contingency.

Next steps: Mike / Olivia, please send your DPA redline and the procurement PO target date to procurement@redwood.com (cc'd) and we'll start the parallel flows.

I'll run a 15-minute MAP sync tomorrow at 09:00 to confirm owners and blockers — invite to follow.
